Sofia.ideal: Held, the way I hold everyone else.
Sofia.gapText: I can read my clients in a minute and I feel lost and numb when I try to read myself.

Diane.ideal: A founder who can rest without earning it.
Diane.gapText: Rest feels like a moral failure and I am ashamed when I stop.

Marcus.ideal: A director who lets a good idea live.
Marcus.gapText: I killed a good idea today because it was not mine and I felt disgusted with myself.

Angela.ideal: Held, for once, instead of holding.
Angela.gapText: I keep choosing the same kind of person and I am afraid it is who I am.

Derek.ideal: An athlete who listens to his body.
Derek.gapText: I am angry all the time and I snap at my kids when I get home.

James.ideal: A great public speaker. I stand up and the room hears me.
James.gapText: I am numb every evening and I call it discipline.
